Article • 04/25/2025 • Applies to: Microsoft Defender XDR
Learn how to configure your Event Hubs so that it can ingest events from Microsoft Defender
XDR.
1. Sign in to the Azure portal
.
2. Select Subscriptions > { Select the subscription the event hubs will be deployed to } >
Resource providers.
3. Verify whether the Microsoft.Insights Provider is registered. Otherwise, register it.
７ Note
Try our new APIs using MS Graph security API. Find out more at: Use the Microsoft
Graph security API - Microsoft Graph | Microsoft Learn.

children: Set up the required Resource Provider in the Event Hubs subscription
Set up Microsoft Entra App Registration
Configure Microsoft Defender XDR to send email tables
